answer:
The actor portraying Jerry Lee Lewis in the 1989 film "Great Balls of Fire!" is Dennis Quaid.

Dennis Quaid's spouse is Melanie Griffith (they are currently married), but they have been married since 1991. Before that, he was briefly married to Lisa Blount (1978-1980). He also had a long relationship with and was engaged to Jennifer Jason Leigh before marrying her.

So the current spouse of Dennis Quaid is Melanie Griffith.
